title: Polynomial-time stored input position
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $t$ be a time function whose unary encoding is polynomial-time computable. Then the function mapping each Boolean word $z$ to the unary encoding of the stored input position at time $t(z)$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: the unary encoding of $t(z)$ is polynomial-time computable
replaced: For every polynomial-time unary time producer, the unary word of the stored shifted input position at the produced time is polynomial-time computable.
